name: Klutz
ability: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player: if they are evil, your team loses.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned when choosing, choosing an evil player does nothing.

rulings.text: Choosing a good player has no effect.
If an evil Klutz chooses an evil player, the evil team loses (good wins).
If the Klutz forgets, the Storyteller may privately remind them.

test_scenarios.name: Chooses good
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Klutz, Bob Seamstress, Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Alice is executed and chooses Bob.

test_scenarios.name: Chooses Demon
test_scenarios.actions: Alice is killed at night; at dawn she chooses Carol.

test_scenarios.name: Poisoned Klutz
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Klutz poisoned by Eve Poisoner.
test_scenarios.actions: Alice is executed and chooses Eve.

test_scenarios.name: Evil Klutz
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Klutz turned evil, Carol Imp.
